author: hadro
description:
African American Travel Guides: Listing Thumbnails
	

108,389 pre-cropped thumbnail images — one per listing — from 46 volumes of mid-20th-century African American travel guides (1930–1966). Each image is a small snippet of a scanned directory page cropped down to a single business or lodging listing: the exact region a traveler would have read.
